item.description: (KYMA) - The eight-time Super Bowl-winning Coach Bill Belichick is not a first-ballot Hall of Famer. item.title: Bills, Steelers and Jags secure coaches
item.description: (KYMA) - Mike McCarthy was officially named the head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers and met with the media. Up north in Buffalo, the Bills are promoting Joe Brady to be their next head coach. The Cardinals are left searching for their next leader as the Jaguars are retaining both their offensive and defensive coordinators. item.title: Imperial Valley Transit Strike Ends After 15 Days
item.description: IMPERIAL COUNTY, Calif. (KYMA) - Imperial Valley transit workers have returned to work after a 15-day strike, following an agreement between Transdev Services, the operator of Imperial Valley Transit, and Teamsters Union Local 542. The strike began after the company created several new job titles without meeting or consulting the union, a step required by law. The post Imperial Valley Transit Strike Ends After 15 Days appeared first on KYMA.

item.title: New massage therapy school opens in Yuma
item.description: YUMA, Ariz. (KYMA) - Yuma healthcare services are expanding! A local family founded and opened a new massage therapy school. The Arizona School of Myotherapy offers a two-semester course with lectures and hands-on training from seven professional faculty members. It also offers a variety of courses like business management, anatomy and kinesiology, and clinical practice. The post New massage therapy school opens in Yuma appeared first on KYMA.
